scope: Independent aggregate local-seat reference totals used only to validate legal replay. They are never forecast inputs.

2011.source: Final 2011 results published from Interior Ministry/MAP and reproduced by IPU; NDI final report appendices provide the allocation formula and district summary.

2016.source: Final 2016 constituency-seat results reported by the Moroccan Interior Ministry and reproduced by IPU Parline.

scientific_boundary: Reference outcomes are read by the allocator-validation replay only. They are forbidden from pre-election forecast generation and rolling-origin fitting.
